newsitem.title: UK: Coopers & Lybrand become sole UK gas claims validator.
newsitem.headline: Coopers & Lybrand become sole UK gas claims validator.

text.p: Claims Validation Services Ltd (CVSL), the agency which verifies that quantities of natural gas have been delivered at U.K. terminals, has appointed Coopers & Lybrand as the sole company to carry out claims validation on its behalf.
At an Extraordinary General Meeting on Friday, CVSL passed a resolution authorising the board to amend its agreement with Coopers & Lybrand.
Coopers will now be asked to provide Claims Validation and other associated services at all onshore terminals for two years from September 1.
There is also an option to extend this for a further three years.
At present two companies, Coopers and the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE), each provide claims validation services at three terminals.
